title: A planned bug's title figure is read from its check's output at planning, not kept from the intake
goal: Planning rewrites a committed bug's title or goal figure (a row count, a share) to the number its check prints on the base, or check warns when the title's figure differs from the premise note's; found in SP-7ff7c5ui: BG-nht352ib was titled '13 of the aliases.csv rows' while its all-rows check printed 21 on the base, as its own plan note recorded

run:
import subprocess, sys, tempfile, os
tool = os.path.abspath("_tools/backlog.py")
def bl(root, *a):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, tool, "--root", root, *a], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout + p.stderr
def story(root, title, premise_figure):
    code, out = bl(root, "new", "story", "--title", title, "--goal", "g", "--touch", "src/a.py", "--check", "python3 -c pass")
    iid = out.split()[2]
    bl(root, "set", iid, "--add-notes", "Premise: the all-rows check printed %s on the base." % premise_figure)
    return iid
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
story(root, "Fix 13 of the aliases.csv rows", "21")
code, out = bl(root, "check")
warn = [l for l in out.splitlines() if "13" in l and "21" in l]
root2 = tempfile.mkdtemp()
story(root2, "Fix 21 of the aliases.csv rows", "21")
code2, out2 = bl(root2, "check")
clean = not [l for l in out2.splitlines() if "21" in l and "title" in l.lower() and "differ" in l.lower()]
sys.exit(0 if warn and clean else 1)
